 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ MISRA  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE UJJAL BHUYAN  For Petitioner(s) :Mr. Rahul Kaushik, Sr. Adv.

This petition impugns an order of the High Court of Judicature at Allahabad dated 14th October,
2025 passed on an application under Section 528 of Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (BNSS).

entities.text: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: By the said application, the petitioner prayed to quash 11:52:36 IST

Reason:
the charge-sheet dated 21st May, 2025 and cognizance/summoning order dated 27th May, 2025 including the entire proceedings pending as Case No.91195 of 2025 emanating from Case Crime No.183 of 2021, P.S. Kidwai Nagar, Kanpur Nagar.

sentences.text:
The High Court observed that cognizance order /summoning order was in respect of offences under Sections 420 and 406 Indian Penal Code, 1860 and as both the said offences cannot go together as held by this Court in Delhi Race Club (1940) Ltd. and others versus State of Uttar Pradesh and another, reported in (2024) 10 SCC 690, it quashed the cognizance order and remitted the matter back to the court concerned to pass a fresh order of cognizance.
3.

entities.text: Delhi Race Club (1940) Ltd. and others versus State of Uttar Pradesh and another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The submission of the learned counsel for the petitioners is that since the prayer of the petitioners was to quash the charge-sheet and the entire proceedings, the merits of the prosecution case ought to have been considered whether it was a fit case where criminal proceedings should continue at all or not.
Therefore, the prayer of the petitioners is that the order be set aside, and the High Court be directed to consider the matter afresh on merits.

4. Though the High Court could have examined the matter on merits, as claimed by the petitioners,
in our view, the petitioners stand to lose nothing if they are given liberty to challenge the fresh cognizance order and the entire proceedings emanating therefrom, in case the court concerned takes cognizance on the charge sheet.

5. Accordingly, this petition is disposed of by observing that in case the court concerned takes fresh cognizance on the charge-sheet submitted by the Investigating Agency in Case Crime No.183 of 2021, relating to PS Kidwai Nagar, District Kanpur Nagar, it shall be open for the petitioner to file a fresh application under Section 528 of BNSS questioning not only the summoning order/
cognizance order but also the criminal proceedings in its entirety.
If any such challenge is laid the same shall be considered as per law without being prejudiced by the impugned order.
6. With the aforesaid observations and liberty, the petition stands disposed of.

7. Pending application(s), if any, shall also stand disposed of.
 (KAVITA PAHUJA) (SAPNA BANSAL)
ASTT. REGISTRAR-cum-PS COURT MASTER (NSH)
